from harness import *
D=4294967295
S=[{'name':'A','label':10},{'name':'B','label':4}]
fails=[]
def T(name, events, want, services=S, limits=None):
    got=ev(job(services,events,limits))
    if not check(name,got,want): fails.append(name)

# --- spawn identity rules -------------------------------------------------
T('spawn/generation', [
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'contains() allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},        # ok
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},        # occupied
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'},        # occupied (any gen)
 {'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,1]},                        # ok
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},        # gen must exceed hwm
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,2],'service':'A'},        # ok
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'ZZ'},       # lexical ok but unregistered
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,3,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'inspect'},
 {'op':'exit','unit':[0,3,2]},                        # wrong generation
 {'op':'exit','unit':[0,3,1]},                        # ok
 {'op':'exit','unit':[0,3,1]},                        # gone
 {'op':'inspect'},
],[OK,OK,ERR,ERR,OK,ERR,OK,ERR,OK,
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,1,2,0]],'units':2,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0},
  ERR,OK,ERR,
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,1,2,0]],'units':1,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

# --- begin/finish, rid high water mark ------------------------------------
T('begin/finish marks', [
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},          # START advanced by A -> state1
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},          # not above mark
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':4},          # below mark
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':6},          # ok
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},        # state1 not accepting
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},        # gone
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':5},         # mark still 6
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':7},
 {'op':'inspect'},
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':7},
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':6},
 {'op':'inspect'},
],[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[D,1],[2,D],[D,D]]}},
  OK,OK,state(1,1),ERR,ERR,state(1,1),
  allow(False),ERR,ERR,state(1,1),
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,2]],'units':1,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0},
  allow(False),allow(False),
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,0]],'units':1,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

# --- begin with no active image -------------------------------------------
T('begin without active', [
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'contains() allow;'},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,2],'rid':1},     # no such unit
],[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[True],'rows':[[0,0]]}},OK,ERR,OK,state(1,0),ERR])

# --- pinned epoch: advancing uses the context epoch, not the active image --
T('pinned epochs', [
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},                 # epoch1 state1
 {'op':'stage','epoch':2,'policy':'match(A,A) allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':2},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':2},                 # epoch2 state1
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1},                # epoch1: state1 -> False
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':2},                # epoch2: state1 -> False
 {'op':'inspect'},
],[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[D,1],[2,D],[D,D]]}},
  OK,OK,state(1,1),
  {'ok':True,'epoch':2,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[D,1],[2,D],[D,D]]}},
  OK,state(2,1),allow(False),allow(False),
  {'ok':True,'active':2,'images':[[1,3,2,0],[2,3,2,0]],'units':1,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

# --- clone -----------------------------------------------------------------
T('clone', [
 {'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A,B) allow;'},
 {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
 {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'},
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':3},
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},       # ok, copies 1 context
 {'op':'inspect'},
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]},       # occupied
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,2],'child':[0,3,1]},       # bad parent gen
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,1,2]},       # child occupied by parent
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,4,1]},       # ok
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,4,2]},       # gen not above hwm
 {'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,4,5]},       # ok
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':3},                # inherited copy -> False
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,4,5],'rid':3},
 {'op':'finish','unit':[0,4,5],'rid':2},                # parent mark inherited -> rid2 not present
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,4,5],'rid':3},                 # mark is 3 from parent
 {'op':'begin','unit':[0,4,5],'rid':4},                 # ok
 {'op':'inspect'},
],[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[D,1],[2,D],[D,D]]}},
  OK,OK,state(1,1),OK,
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0},
  ERR,ERR,ERR,OK,ERR,OK,
  allow(False),allow(False),ERR,ERR,state(1,1),
  {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':3,'contexts':3,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

print('failures:',fails)
PYEOF
python3 t_lifecycle.py
